en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard with Hungarian text. The picture side shows a street scene labeled "Siklósi-utcza" with late‑19th‑century buildings, a corner house bearing the inscription "PRAINL...", and groups of people standing in the street. Ornamental printing decorates the top border, and a handwritten message in Hungarian overlays the image. The other side has printed Hungarian headings, handwritten address, a green Hungarian stamp, and postal cancellations.
